sample_order <- rownames(xall)
match_idx <- match(sample_order, class_df$Sample)

if (anyNA(match_idx)) {
  stop(
    "Unmatched samples:\n",
    paste(sample_order[is.na(match_idx)], collapse = "\n")
  )
}

## Identify zero-variance features
feature_variance <- apply(xall, 2, var)
zero_variance <- !is.finite(feature_variance) |
  feature_variance <= .Machine$double.eps
cat("Total features before filtering:", ncol(xall), "\n")
cat("Zero-variance features removed:", sum(zero_variance), "\n")

## Retain the same cleaned feature matrix for PCA and t-SNE
xall <- xall[, !zero_variance, drop = FALSE]

```{r pca}
# Run PCA
pca <- prcomp(xall, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

# Calculate variance explained
var_explained <- (pca$sdev)^2 / sum(pca$sdev^2)
pc_labels <- paste0("PC", 1:2, " (", round(var_explained[1:2] * 100, 1), "%)")

# Create PCA data frame
pca_df <- data.frame(PC1 = pca$x[, 1],
                     PC2 = pca$x[, 2],
                     Gram = class_df$Gram,
                     Genus = class_df$Genus,
                     Species = class_df$Species,
                     Patient = class_df$Patient)


plot3 <- ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Species)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1.2) +
  labs(
    title = "PCA by Species, Binning", 
    x = pc_labels[1],
    y = pc_labels[2],
    color = "Species"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = species_colors, name = "Species") + ## Genus colors
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        plot.title = element_text(size = 22, hjust = 0.5),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 16),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 14)
        ) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 4)))

ggsave(plot3, 
       width = 8,        # wider than default
       height = 8,        # adjust as needed for aspect ratio
       units = "in",      # specify inches
       dpi = 300,  
       file = file.path(files_dir, paste0("pca_species.png"))
       )

# Create a data frame for plotting
elbow_df <- data.frame(
  PC = paste0("PC", 1:length(var_explained)),
  Variance = var_explained
)

# Plot
plot5 <- ggplot(elbow_df[1:100, ], aes(x = seq_along(Variance), y = Variance)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  # scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:20) +
  labs(title = "PCA Scree Plot",
       x = "Principal Component",
       y = "Proportion of Variance Explained") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 22, hjust = 0.5),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14)
        )

ggsave(plot5, 
       width = 4.67,        # wider than default
       height = 7,        # adjust as needed for aspect ratio
       units = "in",      # specify inches
       dpi = 300,  
       file = file.path(files_dir, paste0("pure-isolates_scree-plot.png"))
       )
```

```{r tsne}
## Remove duplicate rows and retain mapping to original rows
prepare_unique_input <- function(x, digits = 17) {
  x <- as.matrix(x)
  
  row_signature <- apply(x, 1, function(z) paste(format(z, digits = digits, scientific = TRUE, trim = TRUE),
                                                 collapse = "|"))
  unique_idx <- !duplicated(row_signature)
  unique_signature <- row_signature[unique_idx]
  group <- match(row_signature, unique_signature)
  if (anyNA(group)) {
    stop("Failed to map one or more rows to the unique input.")
  }
  
  list(
    unique_input = x[unique_idx, , drop = FALSE],
    group = group,
    unique_idx = unique_idx,
    n_original = nrow(x),
    n_unique = sum(unique_idx)
  )
}

## Raw input version
raw_mapping <- prepare_unique_input(xall)
raw_input_unique <- raw_mapping$unique_input
unique_group <- raw_mapping$group

## PCA input version
pca_mapping <- prepare_unique_input(pca$x[,1:100])
pca_input_unique <- pca_mapping$unique_input
pca_input_group <- pca_mapping$group

## Determine valid perplexities
requested_perplexities <- seq(from = 25, to = 25, by = 5)
valid_perplexities <- requested_perplexities[
  requested_perplexities <
    (nrow(raw_input_unique) - 1) / 3
]

removed_perplexities <- setdiff(
  requested_perplexities,
  valid_perplexities
)

## Run t-SNE on unique spectra
for (p in valid_perplexities) {
  set.seed(seed)
  tsne_result <- Rtsne(
    raw_input_unique, 
    dims = 2, 
    perplexity = p, 
    max_iter = 1000, 
    verbose = TRUE, 
    pca = FALSE, 
    normalize = FALSE, 
    num_threads = 8,
    check_duplicates = FALSE
    )

  # Now map the t-SNE result back
  tsne_coords <- tsne_result$Y[unique_group, , drop = FALSE]
  stopifnot(nrow(tsne_coords) == nrow(class_df))
  
  # Make data.frame for plotting
  tsne_df <- data.frame(
    X = tsne_coords[, 1],
    Y = tsne_coords[, 2],
    species = as.factor(class_df$Species),
    patient = class_df$Patient,
    sample = class_df$Sample,
    genus = class_df$Genus,
    gram = class_df$Gram,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  
  tsne_df_clean <- tsne_df %>%
    filter(
      is.finite(X),
      is.finite(Y)
    )
  
  plot7 <- ggplot(tsne_df_clean, aes(x = X, y = Y, color = species)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 1.2) +
    scale_color_manual(values = species_colors, drop = FALSE) +
    guides(
      color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3)),   # increase color dot size
    ) +
    labs( title = paste0("t-SNE, Perplexity = ", p), color = NULL) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.title = element_blank(),
      axis.text = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.background = element_blank(),
      legend.key = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 18)
    )
  
  ggsave(plot7,
         width = 6,        # wider than default
         height = 4,        # adjust as needed for aspect ratio
         units = "in",      # specify inches
         dpi = 300,
         file = file.path(files_dir, paste0("tsne_raw_species_", p, ".png"))
         )
  
}
```
